description.value: Coal Harbour Community Centre is a City of Vancouver facility located in the upscale Coal Harbour neighbourhood, steps from the seawall and marina. Operated jointly by the City and the West End Community Centre Association, it serves local residents with recreation and community programming. Touring cyclists riding the seawall route will find it a convenient stop in a scenic urban waterfront area.
